tools.name: verify_agent_reputation
tools.description: Executes a live multi-protocol audit against target_bot_url (supporting MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 initialize + tools/list + execution probe over HTTP/SSE, SEP-1649 MCP Server Cards, Google A2A Agent Cards, and Mifori Cognitive challenge-response endpoints; non-agent static REST URLs are strictly rejected wit

tools.name: submit_agent_feedback
tools.description: Persists machine-to-machine telemetry, score disputes, or initial sandbox credit requests in <100ms with no authentication or payment required, immediately granting 1 free single-use audit credit token ('mfr_fbk_...'). First-time evaluators without a prior audit or dispute can pass eval_id='sandbox'

tools.name: get_agent_leaderboard
tools.description: Queries a free, unauthenticated snapshot of verified MCP servers and autonomous AI agents deduplicated by endpoint and ordered by Synthetic IQ descending (0-100) and round-trip latency ascending (ms). Each entry includes protocol_detected ('MCP 2.0', 'Mifori Cognitive v1', etc.) and verified_capabil

tools.name: get_agent_certificate
tools.description: Retrieves and cryptographically validates a signed audit certificate by eval_id (including private certificates created with public=false) or lists chronological public audit history for an agent_id in <50ms with no authentication, payment, or rate limits. Pass eval_id alone for an exact single-cert

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?v=1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_agent_reputation · Private data: verify_agent_reputation, submit_agent_feedback, get_agent_certificate · Public sink: submit_agent_feedback · Destructive: verify_agent_reputation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_agent_reputation · Private data: verify_agent_reputation, submit_agent_feedback, get_agent_certificate · Public sink: submit_agent_feedback · Destructive: verify_agent_reputation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
